scope: PluginRemoval identities, validation and partial-result behavior
positive_observations: Removal validates standardized plugin paths, lstat identity and non-symlink ancestors; no permanent deletion or privilege escalation
Per-item errors preserve failed catalog entries; keep defaults and Cancel-default explicit confirmation present
Candidate REAPER name references explicitly disclaim verified installation dependency
Specific sample roots override broad library roots while nested library exclusions remain
Partial filesystem race is explicitly acknowledged in plan; no atomic/adversarial guarantee claimed
Reviewed Assets reach worker unchanged after identity and bundle-ID comparison with current catalog
Hosted-owner and unknown-ID installations stay separate
Traversal budgets reset per category, allowing project discovery after sample truncation; final issues remain present
limitations: Read-only source review; coordinator reports39 tests and release packaging passed, not independently executed
Native removal/format-sheet runtime validation remains separate
Logic, Ableton, Cubase and Pro Tools full plugin/sample/instrument adapters are upcoming research scope, not claimed implemented
Path-based Trash retains disclosed residual external filesystem race; no atomic adversarial guarantee
No real user content removed or holdout criteria accessed

resolved_findings.title: Publisher prefix collapses unrelated hosted namespaces
resolved_findings.detail: Identifiers io.github.alice.Synth and io.github.bob.Synth both become io.github; same-name plugins then appear as one product and Remove all formats spans both owners. This contradicts conservative separation of conflicting publishers.
resolved_findings.repair: Retain owner-level information for hosted/reverse-domain namespaces, or keep ambiguous identities separate; add same-name distinct-owner regression.
resolved_findings.resolution: Full identifier retained instead of first-two-label publisher; unknown IDs isolated per path. Terminal-suffix boundary still requires repair below.

resolved_findings.title: Removal discards the identities captured by the reviewed installation list
resolved_findings.detail: Confirmation captures Asset values but passes only paths. CatalogModel.trashPlugins re-resolves targets from the current report and can accept newer identities if the report was replaced after the formats draft opened. Current modal UI substantially narrows this route but the model authorization boundary does not enforce reviewed identity.
resolved_findings.repair: Pass reviewed Assets/identities into model, require identity equality with current catalog, and validate those captured identities immediately before Trash. Add stale-review/current-report replacement regression.
resolved_findings.resolution: Confirmation passes captured Assets; model compares identities and bundle IDs with current catalog and passes captured assets to filesystem validation.

resolved_findings.title: Format suffix stripping lacks token boundary
resolved_findings.detail: hasSuffix("au") strips ordinary identifier word endings, e.g. com.vendor.tableau becomes com.vendor.table. Distinct same-name IDs may consequently merge despite full-namespace repair.
resolved_findings.repair: Strip only delimiter-separated terminal format components or separately verified vendor-specific forms; test ordinary identifier words ending in format strings.
resolved_findings.resolution: Only delimiter-separated terminal format tokens are stripped; tableau regression present.
